campaign_wide_preflight.reason: P020 covers container inland handoffs, P021 terminal land/gate infrastructure and governance, P129 berth-side dry-bulk transfer paths and P130 storage/reclaim. The dry-bulk terminal-to-landside-carrier receipt/dispatch service-state remains distinct, but generic queue/access, monitoring, support, degradation and restoration mechanics are not new.

campaign_wide_reclassification.reason: Arrival acceptance and outbound release refine one interface service rather than create separate durable owners. Queue/access availability, monitoring/indication, support dependency, cargo-scope confidence, degradation/restriction/isolation and multi-stage restoration substantially repeat prior inland/terminal/service families. Five retained categories capture the dry-bulk landside-interface core and five refinements preserve the important boundaries to P020/P021/P129/P130.
